name: Adaptive Octree Construction with 2:1 Balance and Surface Propagation
definition: An adaptive octree construction algorithm that refines a 3D grid based on implicit function sign changes and geometric features, enforcing a 2:1 balance constraint (no face-adjacent leaves differ by more than 1 depth level) and ensuring manifold connectivity through surface propagation rules.
summary: This method constructs a watertight, isotopic polygonal mesh from implicit functions using adaptive octree refinement with 2:1 balance constraints and surface propagation rules.
